title: A Hike to Steall Waterfall
description:
Join us on the hike to Steall Waterfall (An Steall), one of the most beautiful hiking trails in Glen Nevis near Fort William, Scotland.

In this video, we hike through the dramatic Nevis Gorge to see the 120-meter high waterfall and take on the famous three-wire bridge crossing. Whether you're planning a trip to the Scottish Highlands or looking for great day hikes near Ben Nevis, this trail is a must-see.
